affected_profiles_expected_to_improve: Profiles with invalid structured CareerAssessment output
Profiles with a preserve-experience versus change-role choice conflict
profiles_at_regression_risk: Profiles with short or absent resumes
Profiles using long generated route or step identifiers
universal_rule_changed: Architecture rule: failed CareerAssessment validation must preserve structured diagnostics, attempt bounded fact-only repair, and use a ProfileSnapshot-derived deterministic fallback before report delivery.
rollback_condition: Rollback if repair or fallback accepts unsupported facts, lowers validated seniority, breaks fail-closed HTML delivery, or causes CareerAssessment acceptance tests to fail.
acceptance_condition: Tests must reproducibly prove structured validation codes, two bounded repair attempts, ProfileSnapshot fallback, resume coverage >= 8, route-title-based market steps, callback idempotency, and repair-to-HTML REPORT_READY delivery.
